verificationC.question: AEH-V2-0099 and AEH-V2-0100 are correctly classified as AEH-owned deterministic acceptance/provenance defects.
verificationC.verdict: CONFIRMED for both rows with the exact chains below.

chain: Contract requirement AC-1 (src/core/contract.ts:31-36 binds configured validators command.<id>/<validator.id> after the AEH-V2-0091 repair).

DIRECT run: waveResult is undefined, so baseValidationRequirements = waveResult?.plan?.validationRequirements ?? [] = [] (src/core/run.ts:274); the only compiled requirements are the generated impact requirements.

compileCandidateAssuranceV1 requirements = [...baseValidationRequirements, ...generatedRequirements] (src/architecture/candidateAssurance.ts:353-354); generated impact requirements set requirementRefs: [] and acceptanceRefs: [] (candidateAssurance.ts:206-224).

Base assertion AC-1 keeps requirementRefs ['AC-1'] but dimensions [] (candidateAssurance.ts:396-409); generated impact assertions reference only impact-review-<slug> (candidateAssurance.ts:410-423), so no validation requirement's id/requirementRefs/acceptanceRefs reach 'AC-1'.

resolveVerificationRequirementsV1 filters compilation.validationRequirements by refs.has(id) || requirementRefs ∩ refs || acceptanceRefs.includes(assertion.id) (src/architecture/acceptanceOracle.ts:133-137) -> AC-1.validationRequirementIds = [].

buildAcceptanceEvidenceBundleV1 emits a VerificationRequirement with the empty list (acceptanceOracle.ts:188-190), and evaluateAcceptanceOracleV1 raises VERIFICATION_VALIDATION_PATH_MISSING at acceptanceOracle.ts:329.

Why evidence.requirement-coverage still PASSed: it is a separate matcher that compares contract.requirements[].validators directly against report.checks[].id (src/evidence/graph.ts:31,59-60); it never consults compilation.validationRequirements, so the two gates can disagree exactly as observed.
AEH-V2-0099.fixBoundary: CONFIRMED producer/compiler/resolution wiring: compile and pass base ValidationRequirements derived from the contract requirements' bound validators (with requirementRefs at least ['AC-1'] and ids/check binding that validationForRequirement at acceptanceOracle.ts:265-271 can match) instead of the DIRECT empty set. The oracle gate at acceptanceOracle.ts:329 must remain; the repair is upstream in src/core/run.ts / candidateAssurance compilation / validation resolution wiring.
AEH-V2-0099.durableEvidence: governed-lanes/change-direct-late-terminal.json blockers[].code VERIFICATION_VALIDATION_PATH_MISSING for AC-1; the corresponding validation checks command.fixture-greeting/contract-test passing is itself only asserted (see verificationB).

chain: ParticipantPlan/ExecutionBlueprint carry the controller-issued participantId (src/architecture/participantPlan.ts:48,62,143-144); compileParticipantInvocationIdentity requires binding.participantId === (authority?.participantId ?? options.participantId) and the blueprint participant to match (src/workers/agentPrompt.ts:1449-1450,1473,1515-1540).

bindOperationParticipantExecution stores executionBinding on current.participants[input.participantId] (src/operations/state.ts:1253-1258), i.e. on the controller-issued participant:<digest> authority identity for authority-bound launches (reviewer launches set requireExecutionAuthority:true, src/agents/reviewLifecycle.ts:330).

Runtime session launch returns the Paseo session id; finalizeOperationSession registers the session participant (agentPrompt.ts:1241-1251) and writes the per-turn resultArtifact onto the session participant (agentPrompt.ts:1238,1256-1268).

The receipt binds receiptParticipantId = authority.participantId with the session id as provenance (agentPrompt.ts:1239,1278-1283); recordParticipantReceipt never copies an artifact onto participant:<digest> launch identities (src/operations/state.ts:1179-1184), and settleParticipants only flips non-terminal status at terminalization (state.ts:1710).

currentReviewEvidence finds the participant by executionBinding.runtime.sessionId === details.sessionId (acceptanceOracle.ts:282) and then requires the same record to satisfy participant.resultArtifact !== undefined (acceptanceOracle.ts:285-292), and attributes the artifact from that same record (acceptanceOracle.ts:301).

Durable proof of the split: change-direct-late-terminal.json participants — participant:6784f4c874e14ad8 (Reviewer) has hasExecutionBinding=true and resultArtifact=null, while 62a25bbe-… (Reviewer session) has the result artifact and no binding; review evidence is therefore emitted FAIL (acceptanceOracle.ts:216-234) and REVIEW_STRENGTH_INSUFFICIENT follows at :334-337.
AEH-V2-0100.singleRecordPredicate: CONFIRMED: the oracle predicate requires binding and artifact on one participant record; with the controller-issued authority identity carrying the binding and the runtime session participant carrying the artifact, it can never pass for authority-bound reviewers (sessionId is provenance/join key, not participant identity).
AEH-V2-0100.fixBoundary: CONFIRMED participant-provenance wiring: join the binding-bearing authority participant and the result-bearing runtime session through the durable receipt (participantId + sessionId) as one bounded work unit, preserving every candidate/policy/epoch/binding check and the deterministic reviewer identity requirement. Do not collapse or relax the oracle's identity/evidence rules.
